# `aitbc agent register`

Register a local agent with the coordinator by agent ID.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc agent register [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--agent-id` | text | — | yes | The Agent id. |
| `--coordinator-url` | text | — | no | Coordinator URL (default: config agent_coordinator_url) |
| `--wallet` | text | — | no | Wallet to bind as the agent identity (default: $AITBC_DEFAULT_WALLET); required in enforce mode |
| `--password-stdin` | flag | `false` | no | Read the wallet password from one line of standard input |
| `--password-file` | file | — | no | Path to a file containing only the wallet password (mode 0600, owned by you) |
| `--password` | text | — | no | Wallet password (deprecated: visible in process lists and shell history; prefer --password-stdin or --password-file) |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc agent register --agent-id <agent_id>
```
